# About

Once upon a time there was a dream job opportunity, and the perfect applicant came skipping along, was handed the position, and everyone worked happily ever after…

Meanwhile, in the real world, great applicants miss out on great opportunities all the time, simply because they’re not prepared for the most crucial part of the hiring process - the interview. The truth is - if you want the dream job, you’ve got to have a dream interview, and that’s where we come in.

At Speak\_, we want you to crush it. That’s why we offer tailored company insights, community support, and in-depth interview kits, all designed to help you stand out from the crowd. At a critical time when it’s easy to feel alone and in the dark - we’ve got your back.

So let’s ace your next interview. Let’s put in the work to outshine the others. Let’s combine your skills for the job with our skills for getting the job, and let’s get you hired.
